subject: Not the end of the world
author: Gooner Rhyle
body:
Everyone has this problem. Played Paradise online every day for around two months and without fail as soon as room hits 4 people plus - bang and the sound is gone.

For me, as much as I prefer being able to talk to and hear everyone it doesn't affect the gameplay too much so it was never a major problem. Also not being able to hear some singing 13 year old is a big bonus. However when you've got someone unable to complete a challenge and also unable to hear you trying to help - not great. I'm pretty sure the comm problems are responsible for some of the jumping out of rooms mid-challenge.

I do hope they get this bug fixed soon - would be great if it was sorted in time for (if not included in) Cagney.
